paite: Midiktatte aw, TOUPA ah nuam in la sa un; midik a ding in Pathian phat akilawm him ahi.
heading: Phatna La
english: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

paite: Kaihging in TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen unla; pekging gui sawm nei in amah phat in la sa un.
english: Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

paite: Amah pahtawi in la thak sa unla; husa thupi toh siamtak in tum un.
english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

paite: TOUPA thu adik a; athilhih tengteng muanhuaitak a hih ahi ngal a.
english: For Yahweh’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

paite: Diktatna leh vaihawmna dik a-it nak a; leitung TOUPA zahngaihna in adim hi.
english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thu in vante siam ahi a; huai a omte tengteng leng akam a hu a siam ahi uhi.
english: By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

paite: Ama'n tuipi tuite koihkhawm bang in abawl lemkhawm a; tui thukpite koihkhawmna innte ah akoih hoih zel hi.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

paite: Leitung luah tengteng in TOUPA laudan siam henla; khovel a om tengteng amah lau in om uhen.
english: Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

paite: Ama'n agen a, ahong omta a; thu apia a, ahong omkipta hi.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

paite: TOUPA'N namte lunggelna bangmah lou in a-omsak a; michih ngaihtuahnate bangmah phattuamna nei lou in asiam hi.
english: Yahweh brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

paite: TOUPA lunggelna bel tangtawn in a-omkip ding a, alungtang a ngaihtuahte khang tengteng tan in a- omkip ding hi.
english: The counsel of Yahweh stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

paite: TOUPA Pathian anei nam ahampha uhi; amah gouluah ding a atel mite mah.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is Yahweh, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

paite: TOUPA'N van a kipan in a-en a; mihing tate tengteng amu nak hi.
english: Yahweh looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

paite: Lei a om tengteng a-omna mun a kipan in ahon en zel hi.
english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

paite: Amaute tengteng lungtang sekpa'n athilhih tengteng uh a-enkhia hi.
english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

paite: Kumpipa himhim sepaih tam ziak lel a humbit ahi ngei kei, mihat thahat ziak lel a tatkhiak ahi sam kei.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

paite: Bitna ding in sakol bangmah ahi kei; ahat mahmah ziak lel in kuamah ahumbit tuan kei ding hi.
english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA mit tuh amah laudan siamte tung ah atu gige a; azahngaihna lamente tung ah.
english: Behold, Yahweh’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

paite: Ahinna uh sihna lak a humbit ding leh kial tun a amau tungding ding in.
english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

paite: I hinna in TOUPA angak nilouh a; amah hon panpihpa leh i phaw uh ahi.
english: Our soul has waited for Yahweh. He is our help and our shield.

paite: Amah ah i lungtang anuam ding ahi; amin siangthou i muan ziak in.
english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

paite: TOUPA aw, na zahngaihna ka tung uah om hen, ka hon lamet bang zel un.
english: Let your loving kindness be on us, Yahweh, since we have hoped in you.
